{{Quote|Once again, you have my thanks. The Slavering Arenas would be piteously silent without our beasts.|Tibor|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Slavering Arenas''' were a series of beast arenas that were run by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Lokaibus]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang stole a shipment of war-beasts that were to be delivered to the Slavering Arenas.
